statements.status_notes: The fixed release is opentelemetry-java 1.67.0. The Nessie server is pinned to opentelemetry 1.62.0 because the Quarkus 3.40.1 OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter calls ExporterBuilderUtil.validateEndpoint, which opentelemetry-java removed in 1.63.0 and which is absent in 1.67.0. Moving to 1.67.0 would fail when the OTLP exporter is configured, so the finding remains until the Quarkus platform is upgraded to a release that works with the newer OpenTelemetry API. Reachability of the vulnerable code path in this image is under investigation.

GHSA-ccrj-gw8r-854m is quadratic CPU use in W3CTraceContextPropagator.extract() on tracestate headers; the fix is OpenTelemetry 1.67.0. The 8.4 line ships the Prometheus JMX exporter agent 1.6.0, which bundles OpenTelemetry 1.62.0 under a relocated package prefix; Confluent's common-parent pins that agent and the newest jmx_exporter release, 1.7.0, still bundles 1.65.0. The agent uses OpenTelemetry only to push metrics, and reachability of extract() has not been confirmed.
